## Hosted failure on the current PR head
At `ef654dd14c7753e5be31a4edc6fda684cf7c8edc` (PR #196), [Node 22 job 123249088559](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-context/actions/runs/40813502905/job/123249088559) passes the npm full release gate but fails the Bun full release gate: **440 tests pass, 1 fails**.

The failing test is [test/zero-budget.test.ts:57](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-context/blob/ef654dd14c7753e5be31a4edc6fda684cf7c8edc/test/zero-budget.test.ts#L57), “exact 512-byte receipt succeeds through installed Node and Bun CLI without Git”. The decoded job log at 03:52:27 UTC reports:
```
Error: ENOTEMPTY: directory not empty, rmdir '<temporary-zero-budget-fixture>/.bun/install/cache/@t@'
    at Object.rmdirSync (node:fs:1193:11)
    at _rmdirSync (node:internal/fs/rimraf:261:21)
```
The test registers recursive synchronous fixture removal in its after hook. This is a hosted teardown failure, not a demonstrated production selector failure. The temporary fixture name above is normalized.

## Expected / actual and impact
Expected: the installed-CLI exact-ceiling regression finishes with reliable cleanup and no residual fixture activity.
Actual: cleanup fails in the Bun cache subtree, making the required Node 22 full gate red despite the npm gate passing. Node 26 npm and Bun gates pass on the same head. A prior code-head four-gate pass does not establish a final-head pass.

Independent bounded compiled-module checks at the same head pass 462 broad assertions plus 701 boundary assertions; all 200 exact-budget cases fail at the old head as a negative control. Those checks do **not** exercise native CLI/cache cleanup and do not override this failure.

## Classification and limits
**Observed hosted test failure; not locally reproduced.** A child/cache-lifecycle race is a hypothesis, not a verified root cause. This differs from the already-recorded suggested-command child timeout/null-exit in the PR body. No test thresholds, implementation, dependency pins or workflow retries were changed by this review.

Dedup checked all 196 all-status issue/PR records (two pages), latest PR body/discussion, and the [canonical shared-fragment feature](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-context/blob/ef654dd14c7753e5be31a4edc6fda684cf7c8edc/.agents/pm/features/pm-context-shared-fragment-evidence.toon). No matching cleanup owner/acknowledgment was found. Existing Daily Release issues concern other runs and are not established owners of this new test failure.

## Acceptance / regression protection
- Establish which process/cache activity persists at fixture removal; await or explicitly close owned work rather than masking live background activity.
- Make fixture cleanup reliable, with bounded retry only where appropriate after owned work has terminated.
- Preserve the installed Node/Bun **exact 512-byte** assertions, non-Git coverage, source/compiled boundary properties and existing coverage thresholds.
- Exercise the cleanup-sensitive regression repeatedly and obtain fresh full npm/Bun gates on Node 22 and Node 26 for the final head.
- Keep the failed receipt and distinguish scoped regression success from full-gate success.
